summary: WelcomeStudentPRHistory is a .NET UserControl component for displaying and managing a student's Practice Placement (PR) History, including confirmed, future, and not-confirmed placements. It supports sorting, printing, and visual display customization for records grouped by status and date.
purpose: The purpose is to provide students (and supervisors) with a detailed, interactive report of their Practice Placement History. The report allows sorting, printing, and visual distinction between confirmed, future, and withheld placements. It serves as a dashboard for placement history.

workflows.name: Display PR History
steps: Fetch PR history records for the StudentID using StudentSearchPRHistory.
Determine placement end date using EndDate or EndDateBlock2.
If placement is confirmed or released to temporary assignment, add to confirmed or not-confirmed lists based on WithHoldPlacement.
If placement has no status and ends today or after, add to not-confirmed list.
Bind confirmed placements to the rprPRStudHistory repeater control.
If not-confirmed placements exist, show future panel and bind these to rprFuture repeater control; otherwise, hide future panel.
Customize row display based on ParentPRDID and item type.
Allow sorting by StartDate, PRD_ID, CourseShortName, StatusCodeFormatted, SiteStudentFormatted.
Handle item commands for sorting and rebinding.

workflows.name: Printing Placement History
steps: On cmdPrint click, execute RunReport with PDF format and relevant student/session details.
Display report HTML in lblReportHTML label.

business_rules: Confirmed placements are identified by StatusCode == 'Conf' or ReleasedToTempAssignedStudent.
Placements with WithHoldPlacement are shown in not-confirmed list even if confirmed.
Future placements are those with no StatusCode and EndDate >= today.
validations: Check for UserSession present before binding data.
Validate UUID format for keys when casting.
Ensure EndDateBlock2 is not null before using, otherwise fallback to EndDate.
calculations: PREndDate = EndDateBlock2 if present, otherwise EndDate.
Sort direction toggled between ASC and DESC based on ViewState.
conditions: If NotConfLst.Count > 0, make pnlFuture visible and bind to rprFuture; else hide panel.
system_behavior: Visual display of placement history separated into confirmed and not-confirmed (future) panels.
Row styling is applied for alternating items and based on parent-child relationships.
Sorting via repeater item commands changes order and direction of display.
dependencies: UserSession object for user context and supervisor caption.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, workflow does not proceed.
Invalid UUID formats in keys are filtered out before casting.
Changes to auto-generated fields should be made in code-behind, not designer files.
content_gaps: No explicit data schema for PRSearchStudent fields.
No UI mockups or complete ASPX markup included.
Calculation of sorting expressions and bindings is inferred from code, but not fully documented.
No explicit error handling for failed report generation.
